name: spl_sigil_head_loop
source: LATTICE + Brian's sigil sheet (8 spin frames) and spinning ghoul head GIF (8 frames), downscaled (sigil 1/4, head 1/2 of native pixels) + requantised
title: Sigil head (loop) — the head floats ~2 tiles up, spinning and bobbing on the violet beam; sigil spins on the glowing tile
qaNote: seamless 16f hold: head spins (his 8 frames at 6fps) + 2px bob, sigil spins, beam bands slide up, motes, one light glitch
suggestedUse: Summon chain on the summon tile: spl_summon_sigil_head (one-shot, endsOn the loop) -> spl_sigil_head_loop (hold) -> spl_head_lifesteal_<DIR> as its attack (starts/ends on the loop pose, endsOn the loop; spl_lifesteal_heal on the summoner at hits[1]) -> spl_sigil_head_dismiss to remove it. Anchor = summon tile ground point; config.headPoint = where the head floats.
layering: Anchor = ground point of the SUMMON tile (bottom vertex of its 64x32 diamond): sigil on the tile, head floats ~2 tiles up (config.headPoint), the beam runs to the top of the cell and fades out there. Draw over units on that tile.
